title: Require Failed phase before tracking a machine as failed
answers: Why are Provisioning machines treated as failed during scale up?
When should Cluster API machines receive a synthetic failed provider ID?
Why does a machine failure message make the node group unhealthy?
body:
Symptom: Machines still Provisioning are tracked as failed, potentially making their node group unhealthy after maxNodeProvisionTime.
Root cause: cluster-autoscaler/cloudprovider/clusterapi/clusterapi_controller.go:machineController.findScalableResourceProviderIDs treated a failure message alone as sufficient evidence of failure.
Fix pattern: Require status.phase to equal machinePhaseFailed before appending a synthetic failed provider ID and taking the failed-machine continue branch.
Constraints: This legacy branch requires both a failure message and phase Failed; a missing or different phase must fall through to subsequent handling. The PR identifies this failed-state handling as deprecated and intended for eventual removal.
applies: Cluster API scale-up provider-ID discovery while legacy failed-machine handling remains supported.
